purpose: Limitations shown PERMANENTLY in the Gap panel and on the Method & Validation page. The user cannot hide them.

items.title: No permanently shadowed region (PSR) mask
items.text: SPEC §5.1 asks to remove permanently shadowed regions (PSR) from the reference, but the inventory has no verified PSR mask product. Because the 10 km reference windows are centred on the ROIs, the Site04 window also covers Shackleton's inner wall, which may contain PSRs. The reference slope/relief spread is therefore biased towards the crater's steep inner walls (test window: slope P50 19.0°, P90 33.4°). Read the reference as 'terrain around Shackleton', not as a 'surface operations area'.
items.label: Scientific Interpretation
items.status: open limitation; removed if a mask product is verified

items.title: Roughness comparison has low reliability
items.text: Roughness (330 m RMS of the residual after removing features larger than 150 m) is not measured the same way on different bodies: NASADEM comes from radar (SRTM) and has vertical noise; in the LOLA polar DEMs most 30 m cells are interpolated because of track spacing, so roughness may come out lower than it is (SPEC §1.5). d_rough is therefore labelled 'low reliability'; it is not given less weight than relief and slope (MVP equal weights, rule 10), but the limitation is written on every card.
items.label: Derived Parameter / Scientific Interpretation
items.status: open limitation; the sensitivity test also reports a 'without roughness' variant

text_by_profile.moon: Roughness (330 m RMS of the residual after removing features larger than 150 m) is not measured the same way on different bodies: NASADEM comes from radar (SRTM) and has vertical noise; in the LOLA polar DEMs most 30 m cells are interpolated because of track spacing, so roughness may come out lower than it is (SPEC §1.5). d_rough is therefore labelled 'low reliability'; it is not given less weight than relief and slope (MVP equal weights, rule 10), but the limitation is written on every card.
text_by_profile.mars: Roughness (330 m RMS of the residual after removing features larger than 150 m) is not measured the same way on different bodies: Earth candidates come from NASADEM radar (SRTM) and have vertical noise; the reference DEM is a different product (Mars 2020 TRN CTX DTM). d_rough is therefore labelled 'low reliability'; MVP equal weights (rule 10), and the limitation is written on every card.

items.title: Most LOLA pixels are interpolated
items.text: LOLA polar DEMs are largely interpolated because of track spacing (about 90% of the 5 m product). For Evidence Coverage, ldec (share with at least 1 observation) is reported.
items.label: Observed Data / Derived Parameter

items.title: Limited human-made area and water mask
items.text: Only the NASADEM water/void codes (NUM=0) are masked. There is no verified mask product in the inventory for cities, mines and farmland, so such areas may appear as candidates.
items.label: Scientific Interpretation

applies_bodies_note: applies_bodies: the bodies a limitation applies to. moon/mars = that target's reference; earth = Earth candidates (shown for every target). Cards show only the relevant target and the earth ones.
